surface.product: Vista Cloud Digital Platform, Omni-Channel API (OCAPI)

behaviour.summary: Seat availability is described as live data that is only micro-cached for a few seconds, with a preview=true parameter serving a more heavily cached version for non-interactive display. The same read also returns Available for seats already reserved by the calling order, so availability is relative to who is asking.
behaviour.testable_as: Two reads of the same showtime, one with preview=true and one without, may disagree; and a seat reserved by the caller's own order reads Available to that caller while being unavailable to everyone else.
behaviour.consequence_for_agents: Availability is a cached, caller-relative opinion with an unstated staleness, so an agent that treats it as a fact about the room will oversell against its own promise. CHANGEOVER separates the two questions completely: availability is a read that may be stale and says so, and the only statement about the future is a Hold.

half_life_basis: Cache duration is an internal operational detail stated in prose, unverifiable from outside, and the kind of number that is tuned quietly. Four months.

citation.quote: Seat availability is considered 'live data' and is only micro-cached for a few seconds... Returns the Available status for any seats that have already been reserved for the order.

verification_gap: A few seconds is not a number, and the caller-relative behaviour cannot be observed without an order, which cannot be created without tenant access.
